<style>
.tg-table{margin:1rem 0 1.6rem}
.tg-table figcaption{font-style:italic;margin-bottom:.35rem}
.tg-table figcaption span{font-style:normal;color:var(--site-ink-2);font-size:.85rem}
.tg-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px}
.tg-table table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.85rem;margin:0}
.tg-table th,.tg-table td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--site-border);padding:.3rem .5rem;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
.tg-table th{background:var(--site-surface)}
.tg-note{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:.3rem 0}
.tg-hear{margin:.5rem 0}.tg-hear summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
.tg-hear ul{list-style:none;padding-left:0;margin:.4rem 0;columns:2 22rem;font-size:.9rem}
.tg-hear li{break-inside:avoid;margin:.15rem 0}
.tg-play{font:inherit;font-size:.8rem;width:1.9rem;padding:.05rem 0;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);cursor:pointer}
.tg-play.on{background:var(--site-accent);color:#fff}
</style>
<script src="/apps/shared/soundfont.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/lessons/tagg-tables.js"></script>
